A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same UR2 research work. Their text, equations, tables, figures and Appendices A–E support reliable comparison after matching relocated material.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, component and corpus ablations, training curves and qualitative case studies.

after.justification: v2 retains original evaluations across mathematical reasoning, medical QA, MMLU-Pro and open-domain QA, including appendix analyses.

M1.justification: The retrieval pipeline, curriculum and two-stage rewards are retained. However, v2 replaces I(y_t^i) with y_t^i in Equation (1) while still describing retrieval masking in Appendix C.1. It is unclear whether this represents an intended objective change or a presentation error.

E1.justification: Training and evaluation domains, benchmarks and corpus scenarios are retained. The online-search results in v2 Table 3 already appeared as UR2+ rows in v1 Tables 1 and 2; specifying five-choice MedQA clarifies existing coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in matched main and appendix experiments. ExpertRAG is newly cited but not evaluated. Vanilla RL MCQ already appears in v1; its identification in the training-curve caption clarifies the existing comparison.

E3.justification: Appendix C.3 introduces exceptions to the previously stated 7:2:1 difficulty sampling: mathematics uses 1:1:1, and LLaMA-3.1-8B substitutes easy questions for hard ones. These revise the reported training settings without establishing that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The component, data-filtering, summarizer and corpus ablations, training-dynamics analysis, unsuccessful reasoning-model experiment and Appendix E cases are retained. Relocation, renamed variants and additional aggregate columns introduce no new analytical experiment.

E5.justification: Appendix C.6 retains the training-run discussion and three HotpotQA evaluations yielding 71.7, 71.9 and 71.2 F1. No new repeated-run practice, confidence intervals or significance tests are reported.

E6.justification: Table 1 changes the Qwen-2.5-7B UR2 Medicine average from 65.9 to 66.2, retaining its component scores of 69.6 and 62.8. v2 Table 4 adds ablation averages. Other matched benchmark results are retained; 65.9 persists in some v2 tables and prose.

T1.justification: Equation (1) removes the token-inclusion indicator I(y_t^i) and its definition, leaving y_t^i as a multiplicative factor. This is a non-equivalent change to the formal objective, despite retained masking prose. The remaining equations are unchanged, and neither version supplies theoretical proofs.

C1.justification: Both versions claim unified retrieval-reasoning RL across diverse tasks, supported by difficulty-aware training and summarized knowledge access, with strong baseline comparisons and performance comparable to GPT mini models on selected benchmarks. The shortened conclusion and added milestone language do not materially redefine these claims.

C2.justification: v2 sharpens the reasoning–retrieval imbalance and noise interpretation, attributes online HotpotQA failures specifically to rate limits, and reclassifies 2Wiki as benefiting from full-article context in Appendix B.3. The principal scaling, corpus-realism and computational-cost limitations remain.

D1.justification: v2 specifies the Qwen-3 vLLM version, Qwen-3-8B summarizer parameters, explicit online GPT-4.1 summarizer identity and Instruct variants for vanilla baselines. It also documents sampling exceptions and identifies the training-curve backbone. Release information and appendix prompt contents remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds ExpertRAG by Gumaan and replaces DeepSeek-R1 with it among Section 2.2 examples, while retaining DeepSeek-R1 elsewhere. The discussion adds emphasis on parameterized retrieval, without substantially changing the overall research positioning.

P1.justification: Focused rewrites affect the introduction, related work, conclusion and technical explanations. Section 6 and Appendix B are reorganized, ablation labels are clarified, and Appendix A adds an AI-assistance disclosure. Most prose and all substantive prompt wording are retained.

P2.justification: v2 changes the document-wide typography, margins, headings and caption placement. It consolidates online-search rows into Table 3, relocates several analysis tables and the training plot to the appendix, adds average columns and places tables side by side. The duplicated main-text planning figure is removed while its appendix copy remains.

improvement.justification: The added sampling and implementation disclosures aid reproducibility, and reorganized comparisons clarify existing evidence. However, Equation (1) loses its defined masking indicator, weakening the central mathematical specification, while the Medicine-average correction remains inconsistent across v2. These benefits and regressions leave the net overall quality direction unclear.
